instructions: weave maps a repo: UI pages -> HTTP endpoints -> modules -> database tables, plus spec change records and tests. If the work comes from a spec change, call plan(slug) first: it returns the next task with its files, endpoints and the command to run. When that task is finished, call task_done(change, task) instead of editing tasks.md; task_reopen(change, task) undoes a tick. Start a change with change_new(name); change_delete(change, confirm: true) removes one and cannot be undone. Before editing any other file, call context(files) once: page, endpoints, tables, owning change, open tasks, requirements, tests to run and the command to run them, in a few hundred tokens. Call impact(files) only when you need the complete list. Use search() instead of grepping directories; search(text: true) scans source lines when you need a literal string. changed() tells you what the graph gained or lost since a branch point. Call remember(files, note) after you learn something the next session needs; context() returns those notes, labelled as claims, not evidence. context(depth: "code") adds a short window at each anchor when you need the exact lines. Before saying a task is done, call verify(): it runs the gate on the diff and returns the commands that prove it. No tool returns whole files; text search returns matching lines only, and every output is capped. This server serves several projects: pass `project` (a name from `weave projects`) to pick one; omit it for this repo.
